Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian equities extended their rebound for a second session, with the Sensex rising 685 points and the Nifty gaining over 220 points. Falling crude prices, strong Q2 business updates, and positive global cues lifted investor sentiment and added nearly Rs 5 lakh crore to the BSE market capitalisation.

Markets.title: US stocks: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
Markets.summary: Marvell raised its 2028 revenue forecast to approximately $20 billion, driven by strong demand from AI data centers. Following the announcement, the company's shares surged nearly 9% in early trading.

Markets.title: Honasa Consumer shares jump 7% as Q2 operating update points to strong growth
Markets.summary: Honasa Consumer shares jumped 7% after the company projected strong second-quarter financial performance for fiscal year 2027. Net sales are expected to grow in the early thirties, supported by improving margins and continued brand traction.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Motilal Oswal among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
Markets.summary: Motilal Oswal is one of four stock recommendations featured in the market trading guide for Wednesday. The advisory provides specific investment picks for traders looking to navigate the upcoming trading session.

Markets.title: Rupee loses 13 paise to close at 96.42 per US dollar
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee weakened by 13 paise to close at a two-month low of 96.42 against the US dollar due to foreign investor outflows and oil companies' dollar demand. Reserve Bank of India intervention limited further losses as markets awaited the central bank's policy commentary.

Markets.title: US stocks: US software shares hit 2026 highs as AI disruption fears ease
Markets.summary: US software stocks reached 2026 highs driven by strong earnings from companies like Salesforce and Accenture, along with new AI partnerships. Analysts report that fears of artificial intelligence disrupting the software industry were exaggerated.

Geo-Political.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
Geo-Political.summary: Former German spy chief August Hanning has been arrested on charges of espionage and treason. He is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

Geo-Political.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
Geo-Political.summary: A ship sank in the Black Sea and its crew is missing following a drone attack. The responsible party remains unknown as Russia increases its military strikes against Ukraine in the region.

Geo-Political.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
Geo-Political.summary: The White House defended Donald Trump after he reportedly suggested letting Iran attack Los Angeles and San Diego, claiming his remarks were actually a warning about a nuclear Iran. California Governor Gavin Newsom strongly condemned the comments as "deranged."

Geo-Political.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
Geo-Political.summary: The lawyer representing one of the Cornell 7 is demanding that New York Attorney General Letitia James be removed from the rape investigation. The defense argues that prior public comments made by James regarding the case disqualify her from acting as a special prosecutor.

Geo-Political.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
Geo-Political.summary: Belgian physicist Professor Francis Halzen has won the Nobel Prize in Physics for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects ghost particles from space. This observatory captures elusive cosmic neutrinos, helping scientists better understand the universe.

Geo-Political.title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
Geo-Political.summary: Kenya has confirmed its first Ebola death during an ongoing outbreak. The patient had previously lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where over 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI optimization (AIO) is emerging alongside traditional SEO to drive organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create various types of media. It also offers tools for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council aims to ease compliance, expedite refunds, curb frequent rate tweaks
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council is meeting to consider reducing the business registration timeline from over three weeks to three working days. The meeting, led by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, also aims to ease compliance, speed up refunds, and reduce frequent tax rate changes.

Data & Insights.title: World Bank raises India FY27 growth forecast to 7.1% on resilient demand, exports
Data & Insights.summary: The World Bank raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7.1%. This upgrade is driven by strong domestic demand, exports, investment, and industrial activity, along with potential productivity gains from artificial intelligence.

Data & Insights.title: Govt plans to expand services index to cover 80% of sector output
Data & Insights.summary: The statistics ministry plans to add education, healthcare, and defence to its monthly services index. This expansion will increase the index's coverage of India’s services-sector gross value added from about 60% to roughly 80%.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: Shell sees Middle East oil flows at 80% as Saudi Aramco warns inventories may take 2 years to rebuild
Data & Insights.summary: Shell's CEO reports that Middle East oil exports have recovered to about 80% of their pre-conflict levels. Meanwhile, Saudi Aramco warns that rebuilding depleted oil inventories could take up to two years.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the RBI looks set to hike rates
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is widely expected to raise the repo rate. This anticipated hike is driven by rising inflation, higher oil prices, and global monetary tightening.

India.title: Indian Air Force Gets New Chief. He Was Part Of Op Safed Sagar, Op Rakshak
India.summary: Air Marshal Dixit has been appointed as the new chief of the Indian Air Force. He is an experienced pilot with over 3,500 flying hours who previously participated in Operation Safed Sagar and Operation Rakshak.

India.title: Ahead Of Top Court Hearing, Bhagwant Mann Alleges CBI Raids At His Office
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann claimed that the Central Bureau of Investigation conducted raids at his office. This allegation comes just ahead of a scheduled Supreme Court hearing regarding the matter.

India.title: AAP Sarpanch Shot Dead By Men On Bikes In Poll-Bound Punjab
India.summary: An Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) sarpanch was shot dead by motorcycle-borne men in poll-bound Punjab. This is the second such murder in the state within three days.

India.title: 2 Arrested Over Pak-Linked Spy Module In Andhra, Many Naval Personnel Among Suspects
India.summary: Two people have been arrested in Andhra Pradesh as part of an ongoing investigation into a Pakistan-linked espionage module. The probe, named "Operation Firewall 2026," involves 18 suspects, including 13 naval personnel.

India.title: What About SIR In Tamil Nadu:  DMK's Jibe At Rahul Gandhi Amid Delhi Protest
India.summary: DMK leader Saravanan Annadurai has publicly questioned Rahul Gandhi's stance on the voter deletions caused by the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in Tamil Nadu. This criticism was directed at Gandhi amidst ongoing political protests in Delhi.

India.title: Polling Officer Asks Woman To Vote For TVK's 'Whistle' Symbol, Removed
India.summary: Polling was temporarily halted in Tirupur district after an election officer instructed an elderly woman to vote for the TVK party's 'whistle' symbol. The polling officer was subsequently removed from duty.

General.title: Watch: At the scene of student protests in Lille
General.summary: BBC Europe correspondent Nick Beake reports live from a large student protest in Lille, northern France. The video shows the scene of the demonstration as it unfolds.

General.title: British national arrested in connection with RAF Fairford incident
General.summary: A British national was arrested in connection with an incident at RAF Fairford last month. This marks the seventh arrest made regarding the security breach near the Gloucestershire air base.

General.title: I'd rather have another election than do a deal with Reform UK, says Badenoch
General.summary: Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch stated she would prefer another general election rather than form a deal with Reform UK. She also pledged to reduce the costs associated with hiring workers aged 21 to 24.

General.title: PCs who used Taser and baton on amputee, 92, sacked
General.summary: Two police officers who used a Taser and a baton on a 92-year-old amputee at his care home have been sacked. A disciplinary hearing found that both officers used unnecessary force against Donald Burgess.

General.title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you
General.summary: The Warner Bros. deal is expected to significantly alter both the entertainment and news industries. Consumers may face higher prices for streaming services and other media as a result of the agreement.

General.title: Watch: How Russia responded to US after plague researcher death
General.summary: The United States and Russia have each offered to help one another tackle infectious diseases. This mutual offer follows the death of a plague researcher.
